name: BUSHRA ASAD
headline: Software Engineer & UI/UX Designer
shortIntro: Software Engineering student and UI/UX designer passionate about creating intuitive digital experiences and combining technology, design, and AI.
aboutParagraphs: I'm currently a Software Engineering student with a growing specialty in UI/UX design. I care about the moment a complicated system becomes something a person can read at a glance.

My background spans UX research, interface design in Figma, and hands-on software engineering, which means I design with an understanding of what's actually buildable, and build with an eye for what's actually usable.

I'm also building an AI-assisted workflow into every stage of my process: research synthesis, wireframing, content drafting, and even this portfolio's own personal AI agent, which you can talk to below.

projects.name: University Portal — Academic Dashboard
projects.description: A case study redesigning a university student portal's academic profile and dashboard screen, grounded in real user research rather than assumption.
projects.problem: Existing student portals (benchmarked against Canvas, Moodle, and Blackboard, including a review of Canvas app store feedback) buried the information students actually needed under dense, cluttered navigation.
projects.solution: Conducted 4 user interviews and a research synthesis, then used the findings to cut roughly 40% of the original UI elements — defending each specific cut against the research rather than trimming arbitrarily.
projects.outcome: A leaner academic dashboard concept where every remaining element is tied back to a stated user need. [Add final metrics or feedback if available.]

projects.name: Storyverse
projects.description: A UI/UX design project focused on creating an engaging and user-friendly digital experience for discovering and exploring stories.
projects.problem: Users needed a simple and engaging way to discover, explore, and interact with stories.
projects.solution: Designed an intuitive interface with clear navigation, structured content, and an engaging user experience.
projects.outcome: Created a polished high-fidelity prototype that demonstrates a clear and user-friendly story discovery experience.
